startline_value.headline: Make the fast-course case before runners compare another marathon.
startline_value.intro: This Performance concept turns certification, BQ potential, field-cap urgency, and pace planning into a focused path toward registration.
improved: Lead with the runner outcome: a clear BQ and PR proposition supported by course profile, start time, and field proof.
Give competitive runners the facts they scan first: certified course, net elevation, pace groups, record times, and corral expectations.
Keep registration momentum visible while preserving the clean public Performance preview.
paid_includes: A Performance-template page structure tuned for BQ, PR, and field-cap decision making
Official registration CTAs pointed at the configured provider instead of competing side paths
Registration-click tracking attributes that prepare the site to measure outbound handoff intent
